name: Samura Shiina
source:
Shiina is a Vampdoll. She's aloof and charming - and, when it comes to women, an unrepentant flirt.

Shiina originally wanted to be a doctor, but the onset of vampirism made her give up on this dream. Later, in light of her military achievements (and good charms), she was given special permission to attend a medical school, where she successfully obtained a license. Truly, a woman of talent.

She and the former noble Yukine are actually cousins, but since her father refused to recognise her as his daughter, she was left to grow up in poverty. She's a hard worker, but doesn't like others knowing about it.

[Translated from [url=https://vampdoll.dojin.com/character/]the official description[/url]. Official translation can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000960/__The_Novel_Game/?beta=1]on Steam.[/url]]
